scope: Repair Workspace dictation: iOS Safari capture and upload failures, and losses from quiet pieces, brief upload failures, token refresh, Stop and multi-channel microphones. Record the mixed-language root cause without changing transcription. Wake the scale-to-zero voice server when a signed-in person opens or returns to the Workspace, to shorten the wait after Stop. Show the free transcript as soon as the provider receipt is admitted and finish its accounting while the same response stays open. Cut dictation after three seconds at a half-second pause so mixed-language speech loses fewer words. Limit unsent dictation audio by seconds so short pieces and a slow server start do not stop a recording.

keep: Existing composer draft, manual Send, authenticated voice endpoint, account pinning and accounting
extend: Bounded audio start and interruption recovery
At most two automatic retries of passing upload failures
Flush the last audio on Stop
The existing no-credential wake-up call also runs on signed-in page activity, at most once per five minutes, never on a timer
With founder approval on November 27, a client that sends Accept application/x-ndjson receives the free transcript before settlement, usage and completion audit; other clients keep the earlier order
replace: Replace AbortSignal.any with a deadline helper that older iOS supports
deprecate: Ending a recording on the first non-running audio state

architecture.reason: Changes only the existing capture and upload helpers.

auth.description: The browser keeps uploading after an access-token refresh only when subject, session identifier and issuer all match the token held at the start. Any other change stops the upload. Server verification of every token is unchanged.

egress.description: Same destinations and request bodies. Cancellation and the 60 second limit are preserved. With owner approval on November 27, the egress review source hash for voiceApi.ts was rebound; the reviewed wake-up call is unchanged.

cost.description: A segment that fails for a passing reason may be sent up to two more times on the existing free route, each with its own accounting reservation. The existing wake-up request may now start the voice server when a signed-in person uses the page, before any recording; it sends no audio or credential and calls no model.

billing.description: No billing changes. For early-text requests the transcript is published before accounting is verified. A failed settlement keeps its hold for reconciliation; a failed later record is logged as accounting_unverified_after_publication. Admission, reservation, provider receipt bounds and the secret filter still precede publication. Free transcription is settled at zero cost; revisit before any paid speech plan.

tests.scope: Upload works without AbortSignal.any and cancelled recordings send nothing.
Passing interruptions resume, lasting or closed ones end once, and a hung start releases the microphone.
Only passing failures retry, bounded; security, sign-in and quota results never do.
Another user, session, issuer, sign-out or unreadable token stops the upload.
Signed-out and hidden pages send nothing; repeated activity is limited to one wake-up per five minutes.
Early text is published only after admission and receipt checks; accounting finishes after disconnect and failures are held or reported.
A half-second pause after three seconds cuts; breaths, early pauses and silence do not.

rollout: Frontend only. Verify on a physical iPhone from the candidate build before promotion.
rollback: Re-promote the previous verified frontend build; no database changes.
knownGaps: Mixed English, Urdu and Hindi transcription is not repaired.
No physical iOS, Safari, real speech or real provider verification.

blockers: Physical iPhone microphone acceptance on the candidate build.
